item.title: Satellite analysis tracks carbon cost of coastal erosion
item.description: From Texas to Maine, coastal wetlands and marshes are releasing more than 1.45 billion pounds (660,000 metric tons) of carbon into the ocean each year, according to new research supported by NASA.
